findings.statement: Among AI developers on X, AMD’s MI300X is reported to deliver a 22% performance uplift over NVIDIA’s H100, and MosaicML highlights AMD Mi250 as a cost‑effective alternative, indicating a positive sentiment toward AMD’s data‑center accelerators relative to NVIDIA.
limitations: Evidence comes only from X posts in English; no direct statements from cloud service providers.
Sample size is limited to 90 items.

findings.statement: AI developers cite cost and performance advantages of AMD’s MI250 and MI300X as reasons to consider switching from NVIDIA GPUs, indicating demand for alternative accelerator options.
limitations: Statements are from individual X posts, not systematic surveys.
All evidence is in English and limited to a single platform.

findings.statement: AMD’s ROCm 5.4 and PyTorch 2.0 updates enable LLM training on Instinct data‑center GPUs with zero code changes, addressing developers’ need for easier software integration on AI accelerators.
limitations: Only X announcements are captured; no user‑generated feedback or performance data.

findings.statement: NVIDIA is not mentioned in any of the 90 collected items, while AMD appears in 23 items (85.2% of all brand mentions), indicating lower visibility of NVIDIA’s data‑center GPUs among the sampled audience.
limitations: Sample is skewed toward platforms where AMD is discussed; lack of NVIDIA mentions may reflect collection bias.
Only English‑language items dominate the dataset.
